title: Trail warm-up, animal edition
storyboard: Film: naturalist leading 4 kids through each warm-up move at a Bengaluru trailhead, side angle, 2 takes

scenes.headline: Slow, low steps — 10 each leg
scenes.body: Heel down, knee soft, no noise.

scenes.headline: Loose arm swings, side to side
scenes.body: 20 easy swings to wake up the shoulders.

scenes.headline: Balance on one leg for 20 seconds
scenes.body: Eyes fixed on one spot, like a kingfisher over water.

scenes.headline: Warm up, then walk quiet.
scenes.body: Bengaluru day trails for families and school nature clubs.

caption:
Our 1-minute warm-up before a trail.

The kingfisher move is borrowed from real life: common kingfishers hunt from perches anywhere from a few centimetres to a few metres above the water.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Alcedo atthis). Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Workout format turned into a kid-friendly trailhead warm-up named after animals; animal clips illustrate each move, naturalist demo storyboarded. No health claims.
